answer: The ledger that matters is Comethunter orbit standard attested before the eclipse tally: 6-year night-watch service, 81 supervised sightings, night-watch exam, annual tally, written by clerks who never met the applicant. A farm either pays 45854 POA up front or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool. Judge it by the violet: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the zephyr: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the summit: a file that outlives the farm. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
